'''Spotted ratfish''' are a type of aquatic [[vermin]] found only in [[temperate]] [[ocean]]s,  and are a ready source of [[food]] when [[fish cleaning|cleaned]] at a [[fishery]].

Some [[dwarves]] [[Preferences|like]] spotted ratfish for their ''coloration''.

[[File:Vermin-SpottedRatfish.JPG|thumb|center|300px|Admired for its ''coloration''.]]
